title: AI-Powered Math Teaching Assistant - Process-level Feedback & Assessment
summary: ZEZEDU reports that students improved after one month of using its CherryPot math assistant and that internal benchmark scores rose about 17 percentage points, with no independent evaluation.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: ZEZEDU reports academic improvement after one month of CherryPot use across Korean schools and describes plans to expand deployment. The ITU account, current as of June 2025, gives no effect size and no independent outcome evaluation. In 2026 ZEZEDU reported that CherryPot ran in more than 200 partner schools and that internal benchmark scores rose by about 17 percentage points on average. The company gives no method or comparison group for that figure. On its home page the company states that automated grading saves each teacher more than 10 hours a week, without giving a method. The company says that U.S. district pilots are underway and that it plans a quasi-experimental study with U.S. districts in the 2026-27 school year.
purpose: Provide process-level math feedback and automate grading.
